column1: Use this spreadsheet to prepare catalogue items before adding them in Sokoos. The current frontend only validates file selection; uploading this file does not import items or update the AI Employee yet.
Each data row maps to the current catalogue item model. Enter one product or service per row below the column headers.
price is required for the current pricing-complete status.
Use one of the current item types: Product; Service; Subscription; Digital Product; Membership; Rental.

Use a category that exists in your Catalogue workspace. Starter categories are Restaurant; Retail; Clinic; School; Real Estate; Salon; and Electronics. The current UI also allows categories to be added or renamed.
Price is stored as text. Use the same format shown in the current UI, for example $8.50 or $250,000.
Availability is stored as text. Current examples include In stock; Low stock; By appointment; and Available.
Separate multiple tags with a semicolon.
The current item model stores currentStock and lowStockThreshold as numbers when provided. stockStatus and warehouseLocation are text. File selection does not validate CSV values yet.
image is a text image URL or path when available. Product media is added through the existing item media UI and is not represented by a CSV column.
